items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-03
items.q: Joe Thomas came in who was an excellent trumpet player. And he sat down with us for a while

ctx.x: But he understood what the music was about.

Oh, he certainly did. He had a very clear concept of what it was about. And he understood the role of his instrument. He also understood the role of the other instruments. And he was frequently frustrated by the fact that the other musicians frequently didn't understand. And I remember one time when I was having lunch, I think it was lunch I was having with Sidney, and Joe Thomas came in who was an excellent trumpet player. And he sat down with us for a while, and I was considering the possibility of asking him…
I find it very difficult to think of many trumpet players that really suited his clarinet playing, specifically I'm speaking.
